responses.draft_cover_letter:
I’m excited about the Backend Developer role at Fernway Travel, where I can bring a strong background in data‑driven backend engineering to a hybrid Bristol team. My recent work centered on designing and maintaining robust PostgreSQL schemas, including partitioning large tables and tuning queries for high‑volume invoice processing, which aligns directly with your need for reliable booking tools.

Beyond database expertise, I have built and maintained clean, well‑tested codebases. I introduced pytest suites, contract tests, and automated GitHub Actions pipelines that enforce quality at every commit, ensuring that new features are released with confidence. This focus on testability matches your requirement for clean, tested code.

I also have hands‑on experience with Docker, Terraform, and the broader AWS ecosystem (ECS, S3, RDS). Together with Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, these tools have allowed me to deliver reproducible environments and observable services at scale, supporting rapid iteration and reliable deployments.

While I have not yet worked with Django, Django REST Framework, or Celery, I am eager to apply my proven backend practices to these technologies and am confident I can ramp up quickly. I look forward to contributing to Fernway Travel’s booking platform and growing alongside your team.
